name: screenshot-inline-animal-references
validationNotes: This is a source-reference draft, not a compileTextDraft input. No allocation, pointer redirection, menu integration, build or deployment is requested.
Only the two missing dynamic labels and the two complete screenshot selection menus are included: nine new labels, not duplicate field dialogue or enemy-name translations.

For each inline menu, start is inclusive and end exclusive. originalHex covers the entire observed choice stream through its 00 terminator. Only entry.originalHex label spans may change; preserve every intervening byte verbatim.

In particular preserve 25 86 19 01/02/04/08 before the four opponents and 01 2c after each label, as well as 21 3e. These callback/control bytes must not be reinterpreted as text, padding or replaced glyphs. Their runtime semantics and relocation operands are not certified by this source-only review.

All nine label strings fit within 14 glyphs. Animal name records retain source kana-mode controls explicitly in segments. Future inline encoding must use glyphs valid for the menu parser; no encoded replacement bytes are generated here.

Field-message records 0x70039:35 and :36 already supply the Chinese sentence around the dynamic animal labels seen in screenshots 24 and 25. Opponent battle names already exist in menu.zh-Hant.json but do not cover these separate inline-menu addresses.
